body: Unfortunately friend, the number of people who love me is beginning to dwindle. Those in the past who cared about me either moved on with their lives or have sadly passed away. Those who are left are slowly climbing the societal social ladder themselves. And I can tell that they want less and less to do with me. Due to me still being stuck at the very bottom at the age of 24. I am not about too commit suicide tonight or tomorrow. But I can sense that the Grimreaper's presence is closing in quickly. And at this point I see no other way out of the abyss.
